structuralObservation: This is the second consecutive turn in which the repair of one reviewer's MUST-FIX had to be checked for collateral damage to the other reviewer's landed MUST-FIX. Turn 2 repaired ADV-D100-01 by re-keying three clauses to 'row' and thereby opened the Windows hole; turn 3 repaired that by making the two keys conjunctive rather than by reverting, which is why both findings now hold simultaneously. The conjunctive form is the durable one and I note it as the reason this cycle converged.
